jobs.title: Medical Product Owner
jobs.description: Vision RT is a fast-growing MedTech company transforming radiation therapy for cancer patients by helping make it more accurate, effective, and comfortable. The company is the inventor of, and a market leader in, Surface Guided Radiation Therapy (SGRT). This technology uses advanced 3D cameras to track surface data, providing enhanced guidance across every step of the radiotherapy workflow. Our systems are used in over 3,000 clinics worldwide, including in 29 of the top 30 Best Hospitals for Cancer (source: US News and World Report 2026 rankings). The company is recognized as one of Britain’s fastest-growing private tech companies, as featured in the 2025 Sunday Times 100 Tech list. Vision RT is also a recipient of the 2026 King’s Award for Enterprise, our fifth in 10 years. It is the UK’s most prestigious accolade for business excellence. Company video (Available on application page) With around 400+ employees globally and offices in the UK, Poland, and the USA, Vision RT operates independently as part of the Danish company William Demant Invest A/S, one of the world’s largest investors in healthcare companies. Employees benefit from the security and reach of being part of a large global enterprise, combined with the agility and innovation of a startup. Vision RT is a company with strong values, a clear mission, and a bright future. It is an exciting and rewarding organization in which to work. About the role: As a Product Owner, you will support Product Management in creating the company Product Portfolio. This role involves collaborating with various stakeholders to align on delivery strategies, converting roadmap goals into actionable plans, and prioritizing the product backlog. You will have daily contact with engineering R&D teams, helping them understand customer needs and translate those into tangible solutions. Enhancing user experience and maintaining a structured backlog are essential. Travel Expectation: Approximately 10-25%, mainly EMEA Key Responsibili

jobs.description: Precision for Medicine is looking for an experienced Clinical Trial Manager to join our growing team. Candidates can work remotely in Hungary, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Slovakia, UK or Spain. Precision for Medicine is a precision medicine CRO. Precision’s uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical experts, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology, in addition to working across other therapeutic areas. You will be the hub of central intelligence for the studies you will be managing and will lead CRAs and oversee all clinical aspects of your study across multiple countries, ensuring timeline adherence and scope, whilst ensuring quality delivery. We encourage high-energy, dedicated professionals who enjoy a challenge, thrive in the details and flourish in dynamic environments to explore this opportunity. We are addressing the challenges facing the research and development of novel compounds in Oncology and are dedicated to positively impacting the health and lives of patients around the world. If you take a consultative approach to trial management, proving to be a valuable partner in the trial operational delivery process, don't miss exploring working with us. About You: You love having responsibility and a say in how clinical trials are run You plan ahead, but have alternative options and a flexible approach You are client focused You are well organised and able to manage timelines and shifting priorities, without sacrificing quality. jobs.title: Clinical Research Associate
jobs.description: Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. At Precision for Medicine we have brought together new technologies, expertise and operational scale to help the life sciences improve the speed, cost and success rate of bringing life-changing therapies to patients. What sets us apart is the way we integrate clinical trial execution with deep scientific knowledge, laboratory expertise and advanced data sciences. We have a strong focus on Oncology and Rare Disease. Precision for Medicine is looking for Senior/Clinical Research Associate. Position Summary: The Senior/CRA has wide-ranging and broad experience and typically handles the most complex and advanced assignments. Responsibilities will be dependent upon the type and timing of the program to which the Senior CRA is assigned and will, at a minimum, include start-up and study implementation activities, on-site monitoring of clinical research studies as well as on-going site management. Incumbents are expected to be able to manage appropriately sized or complex clinical trials, and support Clinical Trial Managers and/or Project Managers with trials as required. An increased focus on training and mentoring junior staff members may be expected. jobs.description: About Lantern Lantern is the specialty care platform connecting people with the best care when they need it most. jobs.description: 🎤 Why voize? Because we’re more than just a job! At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people . Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact. Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload. As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission! 💡 Your Mission As a Senior Fullstack Engineer at voize, you will be a co-owner of voize's ML App - the in-house platform for annotation, data exploration, ML training orchestration, model evaluation, and the HIPAA-bearing data flows that move PHI from customer to model. jobs.title: Clinic Area Lead, North & Midlands
jobs.description: Mission Neko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne. In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. We design and build our own hardware, software and clinical protocols, and more than 100,000 members have already had a scan, with 75% booking and prepaying their next one before they leave. As a team, we chase 10X, not 10%, and we’re looking for people who think the same way to help us scale what we’ve started in Sweden, the UK, and now the US. Join the clinicians, engineers and business builders making prevention a routine part of care. Role Purpose As the Clinic Area Lead, you will be accountable for bringing Neko Health’s operating model, culture, and member first standards to life across an existing portfolio of clinics in Birmingham and Manchester, as well as future clinics outside of London. This role sits at the intersection of leadership, execution, and local adaptation, ensuring that global ways of working translate into consistently high quality experiences on the ground, while continuing to mature and evolve as we scale. Reporting to the Country Manager, UK, you will own regional performance end to end, from new site readiness through sustained multi-site operations. You will act as the cultural and operational anchor for Neko Health in Birmingham and Manchester, setting expectations, building capability, and reinforcing how clinics lead, operate, and serve members. What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months Continue embedding Neko Health’s operating model across the Birmingham and Manchester clinics, focusing on strong leadership behaviours, cultural norms, and consistent execution rather than net-new process design. jobs.description: Â POSITION SUMMARY: Job Function: Clinical Operations Title: Senior Clinical Trial Systems Lead The Senior Clinical Trials Systems Lead serves as the business owner representative for Clinical Operations systems, such as CTMS and eTMF. This role defines business problems and intended use, facilitates the prioritization for system updates and enhancements, coordinates handoff to IT and product partners, reviews designs and prototypes iteratively, and coordinates user acceptance testing and go-live approval. This individual will work in partnership with IS&T, Product, UI/UX, QA, Training, and the vendors who design, build, and validate outsourced systems. The role is also the day-to-day business point of contact for users and cross-functional teams, supporting troubleshooting, and continuous system improvements. The Senior Clinical Trials Systems Lead helps ensure that systems meet the requirements of study protocols, regulatory standards, business objectives, and user needs, and are fit for their intended use. Â PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: Partner directly with clinical science, quality, and regulatory teams to plan, test, and deploy new clinical systems and enhancements. Support system compliance with FDA, EMA, and ICH-GCP standards by defining GxP impact for all changes. Work closely with IS&T, QA, and product teams to manage system integrations, upgrades, and vendor service levels. Document stakeholder requirements clearly, identify process gaps, and propose actionable solutions. Review system designs and prototypes iteratively, providing fast, direct feedback. Coordinate and execute user acceptance testing (UAT), documenting results to provide final business sign-off. Serve as the primary functional support contact for internal teams, troubleshooting issues and escalating technical blockers to IS&T.
